prompt: What were the top 5 Billboard songs by musical groups in the year 1985?
answer:
According to Billboard’s **1985 Year-End Hot 100**, the top five songs credited to musical groups or duos were:

1. **“Careless Whisper” — Wham! featuring George Michael** — No. 1  
2. **“Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go” — Wham!** — No. 3  
3. **“I Want to Know What Love Is” — Foreigner** — No. 4  
4. **“Out of Touch” — Daryl Hall & John Oates** — No. 6  
5. **“Everybody Wants to Rule the World” — Tears for Fears** — No. 7  

*Note: Billboard sometimes listed “Careless Whisper” under George Michael alone, but it is generally associated with Wham! and is included here as a group-associated recording.*
